title: 07 — Station launch from approved upgrade ending

assistant_visual_review.method: Twenty native samples every0.25 seconds plus nine context-join samples every0.125 seconds and full-frame decoding; approved source/diagnostic endpoints also inspected. Numeric audio review only, not continuous playback/listening.
observations: Starts from the approved standing Riley pose and same cleared station composition. Gold dress, bob, face/neck cyberware, human limbs with narrow chrome accents and dark/gold boots broadly retained.
Riley looks and turns screen left, then starts a visible running push-off around2.2–2.5 seconds.
She travels diagonally left and away along the platform, shrinking with distance; tracks stay empty and no train reset is visible.
Narrow cyan/magenta wake follows the run; camera/background remain broadly fixed.
Diagnostic-return-to-launch comparison has close composition/pose continuity around its one-second join in sampled frames.
limitations: Launch is much later than the requested0.5 seconds; wind-up occupies roughly the first two seconds. This is not yet an immediate takeoff in the existing1.25s slot.
She remains visible in the far distance through the ending; requested clear exit/empty-platform hold by1.8 seconds was not achieved.
Full-speed impact, foot contacts and exact likeness require playback judgment; sample images do not establish believable sprint cadence.
Native audio decoded and measured only; no independent listening or speech/music absence approval.
No final range selection, retiming or accepted-ad replacement. Continuity review preserves all native timing so the delay remains visible.

user_preference.scope: Preferred original MiniMax launch movement over station-launch Seedance v01; use with diagnostic video as reference for one new continuous 480p Seedance take.
